condition: Aspirin resistance: Vascular diseases are common problems and aspirin is used as an anti-platelet drug to prevent thrombosis. Published data suggest that 5 - 45% of patients are 'aspirin resistant'. The mechanisms of aspirin resistance are poorly understood.
